title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcer race causing regional failover not to trigger
author: Avery Chen
description: Production incident: eu-west experienced elevated tail latency and SLO breaches during a KV cache pressure event; regional failover did not trigger because the SLO enforcer's evaluation window could race with the circuit-breaker state transition. This hotfix tightens locking in the SLO enforcer, normalizes metric aggregation windows, and adds a short-circuit path to ensure failover is scheduled when circuit breaker enters OPEN due to sustained SLO violations. Also includes improved telemetry and an integration test that repros the race. The change is intentionally small and scoped: 1) Fix race in slo_enforcer.go by making state transitions atomic and adding a reconcile loop to surface transition failures, 2) Adjust circuit_breaker thresholds and sampling window to align with our rollout SLOs, 3) Add routing fallback in routing/policy.go to immediately route new traffic to replica region when breaker is OPEN, 4) Add unit and integration tests that simulate KV cache pressure and verify failover triggers, 5) Add metrics and tracing spans for transition events to help postmortems. See commits for details. This PR was tested locally and in canary; CI passed. Merged as a squash hotfix to main to expedite rollout.
commits: fix(slo): make state transitions atomic and add reconcile loop
perf(slo): align aggregation window with breaker sampling
fix(routing): short-circuit routing to replica region when breaker OPEN
test(slo): add integration test reproducing race under cache pressure

release_notes: Hotfix: Fixed a race in SLO enforcer that could prevent regional failover under KV cache pressure. Improved failover reliability and added telemetry. Backported to release branch by ops team.
